name: Floury broth recipe
summary: A flour-dusted recipe card for sick-bed broth, in the baker Holly Aster's hand.
text: Simmer the root and barley slow and skim the top clean before you salt it. The truth is Siv's marrow bones make a far better broth than mine ever does, though I would bite my tongue clean through before I said a word of it to her. H.
